text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh......... Nobody's here? I could have 
sworn I just heard a voice――

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, this is utterly ridiculous...! 
Surely this must be the doing of those 
folks from the URA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In reality, there's just no waaaay some 
kind of invisible presence could ever 
speak.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Look, I know someone is there! I won't get 
mad, so please come out right now...!
